counterfactual_missing_items: No evidence of left ventricular hypertrophy to support hypertensive heart disease
No amyloidosis-specific findings (e.g., cardiac MRI, biopsy) to support cardiac amyloidosis
No ischemic changes or alternative etiology for conduction disease
decisive_items: third-degree AV block with minimum heart rate of 36 beats/min
Mobitz type I second-degree AV block
response.rationale: R5 uniquely captures the full spectrum of AV block (first-degree, Mobitz I, third-degree) which is characteristic of Lev disease in an elderly patient with RBBB and LAFB. R6 only captures the high-degree block and PR prolongation, missing the Mobitz I and first-degree. Other candidates are isolated findings or speculative.

rejected.why: Hypertension alone does not explain the conduction blocks.
LAFB is a single ECG finding, not a diagnosis.
Pulmonary hypertension is a consequence, not the primary diagnosis.
Left atrial enlargement is a nonspecific finding.
